C1 adds anatomical specificity (common plantar digital nerves) but relies on a single raw span and is an append-only completion of R2; R2 is more comprehensive and directly matches the vignette's final impression. R3 is contradicted by absent neurofibromatosis history, and R1 lacks imaging support despite symptom overlap.
